description: Settled the rushes from her own bag, and would not make a story of the coin.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Roared into the barrel, and was heard as far as the barrel.
name: Edmund Shakespeare

description: Brought the lath, and caught the wasp-apple in the ransom.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Got the colander back before the parsley became a household matter.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Kept the stall in order, and would not have the belt out for a kitchen payment.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Refused the woman's part, took the colander, and held the ransom.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Counted eighteen pair for the stall, and set a cuff aside to be stitched.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Asked what kind of piece it was, and kept tomorrow's count.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Laughed, spoke the four lines, and did not give an ending.
name: William Shakespeare
